name: Floci Local Cloud
postCreateCommand: sh -c 'if ! command -v tar >/dev/null 2>&1; then microdnf install -y tar git unzip zip python3; fi && if ! command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -s "https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip" -o "awscliv2.zip" && unzip -q awscliv2.zip && ./aws/install && rm -rf aws awscliv2.zip; fi && bash scripts/verify.sh'
